budget_items.topic: Stone Farm Estates surety, suggested amount to retain
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The reviewing engineer suggested retaining $27,000.00, based on a 15% adjustment for prevailing wages, for construction items unfinished at turnover to the condominium association.
budget_items.quote: the suggested amount to be retained, provided by the board's reviewing engineer, was $27,000.00 based upon a 15% adjustment for prevailing wages.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The motion released $ 740,984.25 from a remaining balance of $ 767,984.25, leaving $27,000.00 held.
budget_items.quote: d. prokowiew made a motion to release $ 740,984.25 from the remaining balance of $ 767,984.25; to leave a balance of $27,000.00, seconded by m. jeffreys.

budget_items.topic: Stone Farm cost to complete work vs. incentive to developer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident asked about the developer's incentive to finish the work if only $27,000.00 is withheld and the work costs the same; staff said the figure uses prevailing wage Town cost.
budget_items.quote: if only $ 27,000.00 is being withheld and the work will cost $ 27,000.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The developer's engineer submitted a cost slightly under $15,000.00 for the work, so the developer may finish for less and would want any remaining funds back.
budget_items.quote: the developer's engineer submitted a cost of slightly less than $ 15,000.00.
